name: orch
description: Real orchestrator-pattern pack (v1.2.0l NEW, .5 UPSTREAM STDOUT INJECTION): aggregate-results now actually parses dispatch-commands stdout via ${step::dispatch-commands::stdout} template variable (separators are `::` to avoid bash's `.` parameter-modifier conflict) instead of hardcoding 19/7. Closes 'echo hardcoded values' (v1.2.0l.4), 'echo user prompt' (v1.2.0l.0), 'LLM chat instead of bash' (v1.2.0l.2), 'colon-split parser bug' (v1.2.0l.3) bugs reported 2026-09-15.

steps.name: spawn-workers
steps.input_ref: bash:-c:echo "[spawn-workers] 2 workers spawned at $(date +%s)"; echo "user prompt -> ${task.prompt}"

steps.name: dispatch-commands
steps.input_ref: bash:-c:printf "[commander-1] computing 10+9 -> "; echo $((10+9)); printf "[commander-2] computing 9-2 -> "; echo $((9-2))

steps.name: aggregate-results
steps.input_ref: bash:-c:DISPATCH_OUT="${step::dispatch-commands::stdout}"; C1=$(printf '%s\n' "$DISPATCH_OUT" | grep -E '\-> [0-9]+' | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+$'); C2=$(printf '%s\n' "$DISPATCH_OUT" | grep -E '\-> [0-9]+' | tail -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+$'); echo "[aggregate] commander-1 result = $C1 (from dispatch-commands)"; echo "[aggregate] commander-2 result = $C2 (from dispatch-commands)"; echo "[aggregate] task complete -> ${task.prompt}"
